svg.title: Address lifecycle
svg.desc: For each type, shipping and billing. Nothing is sent until every field the country requires is valid, and so is each optional field the shopper filled. Then address.entered, once. A later change that is still valid sends address.updated; a change that makes it invalid sends nothing, and the Checkout keeps the last valid address. A billing address counts only while billing is separate from shipping.

text.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

g.text: a field is missing or wrong

text.style: fill: var(--clean-accent, #2563eb); font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: Per type · an invalid change sends nothing and the last valid address is kept · billing only while separate
